title: So so worth it!!
text: We enjoyed the tour a lot, Ivan our guide was super informative and detailed. Ivan explained in detail the beautiful architecture and history of the cathedral and Alcazar. As part of the ticket you have a ‘skip the line’ ticket which is definitely needed when you see general admission queues at both venues. The tour lasted about 3 hours in total and you leave with a greater understanding of the city and a few recommendations too. A must do experience while in Savilla! Thank you!
